comment_text='Thanks!'
# candidates, access_token available from prior steps
print('Will process', len(candidates), 'received transactions from friends in date range.')

results=[]
for i,t in enumerate(sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: x.get('created_at')), start=1):
    tx_id=t.get('transaction_id')
    sender=t.get('sender',{}).get('email')
    created_at=t.get('created_at')
    print(f'[{i}/{len(candidates)}] tx_id={tx_id} amount={t.get("amount")} created_at={created_at} sender={sender} initial_liked={t.get("liked")}')

    # Check existing comments to avoid duplicate
    has_thanks=False
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        comms=apis.venmo.show_transaction_comments(transaction_id=tx_id, access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('  comments page', page_index, 'count', len(comms) if comms else None)
        if not comms:
            break
        for c in comms:
            if c.get('comment')==comment_text:
                has_thanks=True
        page_index+=1
        # safety: if fewer than page_limit, likely end
        if len(comms)<page_limit:
            break

    created_comment_id=None
    if not has_thanks:
        resp_comment=apis.venmo.create_transaction_comment(transaction_id=tx_id, comment=comment_text, access_token=access_token)
        print('  created comment:', resp_comment)
        created_comment_id=resp_comment.get('comment_id') if isinstance(resp_comment, dict) else None
    else:
        print('  already has "Thanks!" comment; skipping comment creation.')

    liked_response=None
    if not t.get('liked'):
        resp_like=apis.venmo.like_transaction(transaction_id=tx_id, access_token=access_token)
        print('  like_transaction response:', resp_like)
        liked_response=resp_like
    else:
        print('  already liked; skipping like_transaction.')

    results.append({'transaction_id':tx_id,'created_at':created_at,'has_thanks':has_thanks,'created_comment_id':created_comment_id,'liked':t.get('liked')})

print('Done. Total processed:', len(results))
# quick summary
created_comments=[r for r in results if r['created_comment_id'] is not None]
print('Created comments count:', len(created_comments))
